gen-gf-grandstander-gf-voces: Grandstander keeps every stroke at an unvarying width, loud and expressive. Voces, a sans-serif with modest thick-thin shading and tall lowercase, is the quiet foil that makes that sameness stand out.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-winky-rough: Expressive Grandstander draws curves without any stress, while Winky Rough, a sans, keeps its lowercase close to capital height. Both stay low on contrast, so they sit together easily.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-winky-sans: Modern and level-headed, with capitals barely taller than the lowercase, the body text hardly draws attention. Winky Sans would read smoothly page after page, while Grandstander keeps its steady weight up top.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-yantramanav: Yantramanav is a modern sans-serif whose tall lowercase nearly reaches the capitals, tidy and clean. And Grandstander, which never uses hairlines, feels much sturdier and more expressive beside it.
gen-gf-grandstander-outfit: Grandstander arrives bold and expressive, its lowercase standing tall under short ascenders and giving every word real presence. Outfit, a sans of cable-like curves, handles the approachable, quieter side.
gen-gf-grandstander-plus-jakarta-sans: Expressive Grandstander stands tall in its lowercase, while Plus Jakarta Sans, a precise sans-serif, sits at a more moderate height. Its monoline curves stay open, so extended reading should feel crisp and modern.
gen-gf-grandstander-sora: Bold Grandstander stands tall in lowercase, while Sora, a geometric sans-serif, keeps a moderate height and smooth curves. Sora's open, geometric shapes should keep long reading feeling light and unhurried.
gen-gf-grandstander-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk, a sans with counters that breathe, moves along in a geometric, neutral way beside Grandstander's taller lowercase. Over a full page it should feel steady and unfussy.
gen-gf-gugi-fs-amulya: Amulya comes across contemporary and open, a sans-serif whose curves leave generous gaps. But Gugi, whose lowercase runs tall and whose strokes never thin, stands out boldly against that moderate height.
gen-gf-gugi-fs-chillax: Gugi's terminals are cut open so its counters flow outward, bold and distinctive. Chillax, a casual plain sans with spaghetti-like lines and loops left unfinished, loosens the whole mood right up.
